WITH RECURSIVE date_series AS ( -- 生成最近 7 天的日期 SELECT CURDATE() AS report_date UNION ALL SELECT DATE_SUB(report_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) FROM date_series WHERE report_date > DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) ) SELECT d.report_date AS 日期, CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(d.report_date) = 2 THEN '周一' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(d.report_date) = 3 THEN '周二' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(d.report_date) = 4 THEN '周三' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(d.report_date) = 5 THEN '周四' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(d.report_date) = 6 THEN '周五' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(d.report_date) = 7 THEN '周六' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(d.report_date) = 1 THEN '周日' END AS 星期, COALESCE(p.putNum, 0) AS 入库数量, COALESCE(o.outNum, 0) AS 出库数量, COALESCE(c.carryNum, 0) AS 搬运数量 FROM date_series d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(create_time) AS create_date, COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS putNum FROM mes_input_log WHERE task_type = '0' AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) GROUP BY create_date ) p ON d.report_date = p.create_date LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(create_time) AS create_date, COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS outNum FROM mes_ouput_log WHERE task_type = '0' AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) GROUP BY create_date ) o ON d.report_date = o.create_date LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(create_time) AS create_date, COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS carryNum FROM mes_carry_log WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) GROUP BY create_date ) c ON d.report_date = c.create_date ORDER BY d.report_date;
